{{Top|leg}}
[[File:StarDestroyerRepairs-SWVisions.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A Star Destroyer in drydock for repairs]]
A '''drydock''', also spelled '''dry dock''', '''stardock''',<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> or '''space-dock''',<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> was housing for [[Starship/Legends|ships]], up to and including [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]], that would not be flying soon, often due to being under [[Shipyard/Legends|construction or repair]]. Some drydocks were [[Space station/Legends|space stations]].

==In the galaxy==
[[File:Dutyfree.png|thumb|left|300px|[[Dutyfree/Legends|''Dutyfree'']] docked at [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]]]]
On the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], its [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] ships were drydocked in the hangars.

[[Imperial Drydock IV]] was located in the [[Greater Plooriod sector/Legends|Greater Plooriod sector]]. The [[Tarkin (superweapon)|''Tarkin'']] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] was constructed in drydocks orbiting the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hockaleg]].

The ''[[Star Lady]]'', the ship of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Fenig Nabon]], was drydocked on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].

==Behind the scenes==
A [[Wikipedia:dry dock|real-world dry dock]] brings a watercraft completely out of the water for easy access to the entire hull. A starship "drydock" has a similar purpose, but loses the literal meaning of the apparatus used for boats and ships.
